en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; it reads like a modern composed song but I cannot name an author. 'Пророси' as 'shed' and the grammar of line 1 ('земјо ми те надвило') are my reading; 'Лешочки' refers to the Lesok monastery near Tetovo.

lines.cyr: Тешко време, јадовно, земјо ми те надвило.
lines.lat: Teško vreme, jadovno, zemjo mi te nadvilo.
lines.en: A hard, grievous time, my land, has loomed over you.

lines.cyr: Луѓе ти раселени, древни куќи ти разурнати.
lines.lat: Luǵe ti raseleni, drevni kuḱi ti razurnati.
lines.en: Your people scattered, your ancient houses ruined.

lines.cyr: Цркви и манастири, ечат од нив уште камбани.
lines.lat: Crkvi i manastiri, ečat od niv ušte kambani.
lines.en: Churches and monasteries, bells still ring out from them.
A falcon flies, it flew over sorrowful Macedonia,

lines.cyr: дробни солзи пророси кога виде луѓе скорнати,
lines.lat: drobni solzi prorosi koga vide luǵe skornati,
lines.en: it shed small tears when it saw people uprooted,

lines.cyr: еј, од својте прагови, сега пусти и разурнати.
lines.lat: ej, od svojte pragovi, sega pusti i razurnati.
lines.en: hey, from their own thresholds, now empty and ruined.
No other land, we have none,
nor other bells.

lines.cyr: Пак ќе дојде ден, ќе се издигне
lines.lat: Pak ḱe dojde den, ḱe se izdigne
lines.en: The day will come again, it will rise up,
the glorious monastery of Lesok.
Steel your heart, Macedonia,
the sun will shine again
and the bells will ring out strongly
over Shar and everywhere.

lines.cyr: Соколе мој, соколе, можат да ни земат сѐ,
lines.lat: Sokole moj, sokole, možat da ni zemat sè,
lines.en: My falcon, falcon, they can take everything from us,

lines.cyr: само не од душава, вечна љубов да ни откорнат.
lines.lat: samo ne od dušava, večna ljubov da ni otkornat.
lines.en: only from this soul they cannot tear out our eternal love.

lines.cyr: Љубов, еј, за нашата мила мајка Македонија.
lines.lat: Ljubov, ej, za našata mila majka Makedonija.
lines.en: Love, hey, for our dear mother Macedonia.
No other land, we have none,
nor other bells.

lines.cyr: Пак ќе дојде ден, ќе се издигне
lines.lat: Pak ḱe dojde den, ḱe se izdigne
lines.en: The day will come again, it will rise up,
the glorious monastery of Lesok.
Steel your heart, Macedonia,
the sun will shine again
and the bells will ring out strongly
over Shar and everywhere.
Fly free, my falcon!
